notes: More detail, about twice as slow now appears where the editor can reach it: in the Enhance tool, and under Upscale on export for a finished edit. The last update added it in a part of the window that stays hidden, so you could not see it, and that was our mistake. It runs the larger model for 2× jobs such as 1080p to 4K, with sharper edges and a cleaner picture, and takes about 1.7 times as long. Free exports of upscaling, restoring and colour work still stop at 60 seconds; Convert, Mute, Compress, Loop and the other tools run at full length, all with the small “Made with Crisp” mark. Pro, $129 once, removes the limit and the mark.
